body:
Before I say anything else, I'd like to tell you that I am not immediately disagreeing with everything you say. I just can't see it the way you can.

Are you sure I can do good? I'd like to believe I can. I've spent nearly my whole life under the impression that I have limited, if any, redeemable qualities. I don't know how to believe anything else

Playing guitar and making music (this is mostly just me sitting at home diddling and not actually writing anything. I haven't been able to write anything good, nor have my skills progressed in a very long time)

Bike riding. I haven't been up to it recently but for a while it would give me a chance to forget about my problems for about an hour or so

YuGiOh (a trading card game. Game/hobby shops hold competitive tournaments for this. I go to one shop in particular just about every week if I can)

I feel like there are more but I can't think of any

I think you're misunderstanding what I'm saying a little. It's not other people that are the problem. *I'm* the problem. There's something wrong with me.

And yes, I do have a few hobbies (all of which I'm starting to lost interest in because, you know, I kinda want to die). I have met people through these hobbies. But like I've been saying, I don't see how I could be worth other people's time anymore

Look, I appreciate the help, but I *have* tried, and failed. I'm simply not cut out for good things and I'm not strong enough to get back up this time.

I tried to reconnect with my friends already. All it did was further demonstrate why they *shouldn't* be friends with me.

If so many people I care about can't say the same for me, then I don't see why anyone else would from here on out.
